Clause 1.1.3 - zoning (land_use_zoning): This DCP applies to the whole of the Inner West Local Government Area for the extent 
of land show n on Figure 1 : Extent of land where this DCP applies .

Clause 1.1.4 - other (development_control): This DCP is to be read in conjunction with Inner West Local Environmental Plan 2022. 
In the event of an inconsistency between the provisions of th e two documents,  the 
provisions of Inner West LEP 2022 shall prevail to the extent of the inconsistency.

Clause 1.1.7 - other (development_control): The purpose of this DCP is to supplement the provisions of Inner West LEP 2022  and 
provide more detailed provision s to guide development.

Clause 1.1.7 - other (development_control): Under S ection  4.15 of the EP &A Act, Council is requi red to consider the relevant 
provisions of this DCP when assessing  a development application.

Clause 1.1.9 - other (development_control): Build upon Inner W est LEP 202 2 by providing detailed objectives and controls for 
development.

Clause 1.1.9 - other (environmental_protection): To maintain and enhance the environmental and cultural  heritage of the 
Marrickville LGA.

Clause 1.1.9 - other (environmental_protection): To ensure that development  consider s the principles of ecologically 
sustainable development,  in particular energy, water and stormwater 
efficiency, solar access, wast e reduction and local biodiversity.
